name: Sarah Jones
bio: Sarah is a powerful ball-carrier who leads the team in metres made. She has been a cornerstone of the women's program for three seasons.

name: Emily Chen
bio: Emily's quick service and sharp decision-making set the tempo for the entire team. She was named Rookie of the Year in her first season.

name: Lisa Martinez
bio: Lisa is an imposing lineout target and a fierce presence in the loose. She brings both size and athleticism to the second row.
